usdRate.sourceName: State Administration of Foreign Exchange, RMB central parity rate (CFETS)
usdRate.note: Central parity 671.38 yuan per 100 US dollars.

inflation_cpi.sourceName: National Bureau of Statistics of China, Consumer Price Index in September 2026
inflation_cpi.note: CPI rose 0.9% year on year (health care +2.7%, education services +0.4%).

inflation_projection.sourceName: Government CPI target of around 2%; 5-year CPI average below 1% (NBS)
inflation_projection.note: CPI has run well below the official target of around 2% for several years, so we plan with 1.5%, between the recent average and the target.

policy_rate.sourceName: People's Bank of China 7-day reverse repo rate (via Trading Economics)
policy_rate.note: The 7-day reverse repo is the PBOC's main policy rate; 1-year LPR 3.0%, 5-year LPR 3.5% (20 Oct 2026).

savings_account_rate.sourceName: Listed RMB deposit rates of a large state-owned bank (demand deposit)
savings_account_rate.note: 0.05% on demand deposits; the 2025-05-20 table was still the latest listed on 2026-10-31.

fdr_3m_rate.sourceName: Listed RMB deposit rates of a large state-owned bank (lump-sum fixed deposit, 3 months)
fdr_3m_rate.note: Still the latest listed table on 2026-10-31; smaller banks pay slightly more.

fdr_1y_rate.sourceName: Listed RMB deposit rates of a large state-owned bank (lump-sum fixed deposit, 1 year)

dps_rate.sourceName: Listed RMB deposit rates of a large state-owned bank (installment deposit, 5 years)
dps_rate.note: 零存整取 installment deposit: 1-year 0.65%, 3- and 5-year 0.85%.

bank_deposit_avg_rate.sourceName: World Bank WDI, deposit interest rate (FR.INR.DPST)
bank_deposit_avg_rate.note: This series is the PBOC 1-year benchmark deposit rate (unchanged since 2015), not a weighted average; actual 1-year rates at large banks are 0.95%.

sanchayapatra_5y_rate.note: Savings treasury bonds (储蓄国债, 3- and 5-year) are sold to individuals, but the Ministry of Finance announcement pages were unreachable and we found no 2026 rate.

tbill_91d_rate.note: No 3-month government bill yield could be read; the shortest tenor found was the 52-week yield, 1.22% on 30 Oct 2026 (Trading Economics).

tbond_5y_rate.sourceName: China 5-year government bond yield (via Trading Economics)

tbond_10y_rate.sourceName: China 10-year government bond yield (via Trading Economics)

tax_bank_interest.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, China: other tax credits and incentives
tax_bank_interest.note: Bank deposit interest income is currently exempt from individual income tax.

tax_sanchayapatra_profit.sourceName: PwC Worldwide Tax Summaries, China: other tax credits and incentives
tax_sanchayapatra_profit.note: Interest on government bonds (including savings treasury bonds) is exempt from individual income tax.

deposit_insurance_limit.note: Up to 500,000 yuan per depositor per insured bank, principal and interest combined.

credit_card_rate_cap.note: PBOC removed the credit card rate band from 2021 and rates are market-set; we could not read a current source for a cap or typical rate.

equity_return_low.note: The main A-share index has had a weak, volatile decade, so the low case is zero.

equity_return_base.sourceName: 1-year deposit 0.95% plus a capped premium; CSI 300 10-year record
equity_return_base.note: Base set about 3.5 points above the untaxed 1-year deposit rate, below the 4-point limit, because the local index record is weak.

equity_return_high.sourceName: Long-run A-share and global equity returns in CNY
equity_return_high.note: High case if earnings growth and valuations recover.

gold_return_low.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; CNY/USD central parity (SAFE)
gold_return_low.note: Gold can stall for a decade and the yuan has been strengthening against the dollar.

gold_return_base.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; CNY/USD central parity (SAFE)
gold_return_base.note: Long-run dollar gold trend of about 5% less a little for yuan appreciation.

gold_return_high.sourceName: US-dollar gold trend; CNY/USD central parity (SAFE)
gold_return_high.note: High case for a strong gold cycle.

fixed_income_return_low.note: Low case at the 3-month deposit rate. Safe CNY rates: 1-year deposit 0.95% and 3-year 1.25% (large-bank listed rates), 52-week government bill 1.22%, 5-year bond 1.37%, 10-year 1.66% (Oct 2026); deposit and government bond interest are exempt from income tax.

fixed_income_return_base.sourceName: Large-bank listed deposit rates and government bond yields
fixed_income_return_base.note: Base case between 1-year deposits (0.95%) and 3-year deposits / 5-year bonds (1.25-1.37%). Safe CNY rates: 1-year deposit 0.95% and 3-year 1.25% (large-bank listed rates), 52-week government bill 1.22%, 5-year bond 1.37%, 10-year 1.66% (Oct 2026); deposit and government bond interest are exempt from income tax.

fixed_income_return_high.note: High case at the 10-year government bond yield. Safe CNY rates: 1-year deposit 0.95% and 3-year 1.25% (large-bank listed rates), 52-week government bill 1.22%, 5-year bond 1.37%, 10-year 1.66% (Oct 2026); deposit and government bond interest are exempt from income tax.

life_claim_settlement_rate.note: NFRA publishes insurer complaint and premium data but we found no industry-wide life claim settlement ratio.

insurance_term_premium_table.note: Term life (定期寿险) is widely sold, but we could not read a credible published premium guide or regulator data in this research run.

health_hospitalisation_cost.note: NHSA publishes average inpatient costs per stay but not out-of-pocket cost at private or mid-range hospitals; not found.

health_premium_table.note: No regulator or credible guide with private medical insurance premiums per 100,000 yuan found.

oop_health_share.sourceName: World Bank WDI, out-of-pocket expenditure (% of current health expenditure, SH.XPD.OOPC.CH.ZS)

goal_inflation_health.sourceName: NBS CPI health care sub-index (+2.7% y/y, Sep 2026)
goal_inflation_health.note: Medical prices run about 2 points above headline CPI, so we plan with 3%.

goal_inflation_education.sourceName: NBS CPI education services (+0.4% y/y) and education, culture and recreation (+1.4%), Sep 2026
goal_inflation_education.note: Measured education CPI is low, but private tutoring, higher education and study abroad costs rise faster, so we plan with 2.5%.

life_expectancy.sourceName: World Bank WDI, life expectancy at birth, total (SP.DYN.LE00.IN)

life_table_remaining.note: Remaining years derived from expected age at death by current age; secondary source because the WHO GHO API was unavailable.

support_ratio.sourceName: UN World Population Prospects 2024, medium variant (via populationpyramid.net); World Bank SP.POP.DPND.OL
support_ratio.note: 100 / old-age dependency ratio: 21.4 in 2025 (World Bank), 41.6 in 2040 and 72.2 in 2065 (UN WPP 2024).

retirement_age_default.sourceName: NPC Standing Committee decision on gradually raising the statutory retirement age (13 Sep 2024), via Xinhua
retirement_age_default.note: From 1 Jan 2025 men's statutory age rises from 60 to 63 over 15 years (1 month every 4 months; full for men born from Sep 1976); women's from 50/55 to 55/58. Up to 3 years earlier or later is allowed.

retirement_age_government.sourceName: NPC Standing Committee decision on gradually raising the statutory retirement age (13 Sep 2024), via Xinhua
retirement_age_government.note: Same national statutory ages apply to civil servants: men 60 rising to 63, women cadres 55 rising to 58.

retirement_return_low.note: Low case at the 3-month deposit rate. Safe CNY rates: 1-year deposit 0.95% and 3-year 1.25% (large-bank listed rates), 52-week government bill 1.22%, 5-year bond 1.37%, 10-year 1.66% (Oct 2026); deposit and government bond interest are exempt from income tax.

retirement_return_base.note: Base case equal to the untaxed 1-year deposit rate, below the 52-week bill yield. Safe CNY rates: 1-year deposit 0.95% and 3-year 1.25% (large-bank listed rates), 52-week government bill 1.22%, 5-year bond 1.37%, 10-year 1.66% (Oct 2026); deposit and government bond interest are exempt from income tax.

retirement_return_high.note: High case at the 10-year government bond yield. Safe CNY rates: 1-year deposit 0.95% and 3-year 1.25% (large-bank listed rates), 52-week government bill 1.22%, 5-year bond 1.37%, 10-year 1.66% (Oct 2026); deposit and government bond interest are exempt from income tax.

retirement_accumulation_return_low.sourceName: Mix of CNY deposits/bonds and equity
retirement_accumulation_return_low.note: About 40% equity at the low case and 60% deposits and bonds.

retirement_accumulation_return_base.sourceName: Mix of CNY deposits/bonds and equity
retirement_accumulation_return_base.note: About half equity at 4.5% and half deposits/bonds near 1.2%.

retirement_accumulation_return_high.sourceName: Mix of CNY deposits/bonds and equity
retirement_accumulation_return_high.note: About 60% equity at the high case and 40% government bonds.

old_age_allowance_monthly.note: The urban and rural residents' basic pension pays a state-funded minimum basic pension from age 60, but we could not read an official source for the current national minimum amount.

old_age_allowance_eligibility.note: Residents' basic pension is paid from age 60 after 15 years of contributions; we could not read an official source on means testing and current rules.

gratuity_rule.note: China has no statutory retirement gratuity; Labour Contract Law severance (one month's pay per year of service) applies to dismissals and contract ends, not to retirement.

public_pension_scheme.sourceName: NPC Standing Committee decision on gradually raising the statutory retirement age (13 Sep 2024), via Xinhua
public_pension_scheme.note: Urban employees' basic pension: men's pension age rising from 60 to 63 (women 50/55 to 55/58); minimum contribution years rise from 15 to 20 from 2030 (6 months a year). Pensions are raised yearly by government decision, not indexed by law.

sanchayapatra_5y.note: 3- and 5-year savings bonds (certificate and electronic) sold to individuals through banks; not tradable.

tbill_91d.note: Short-term government bills can be bought by individuals through bank counters or the stock exchanges.

tbond_5y.note: Bought through bank counters or the stock exchanges.

tbond_10y.note: Bought through bank counters or the stock exchanges.

equity_fund.note: Public mutual funds and index funds tracking broad A-share indices are widely available.

gold.note: Gold bars and coins are sold by banks and jewellers.

insuranceComplaints.name: National Financial Regulatory Administration consumer protection (hotline 12378)

pensionScheme.name: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, basic pension insurance

oldAgeAllowance.name: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, urban and rural residents' basic pension
oldAgeAllowance.note: State-funded basic pension from age 60 within the residents' scheme.

publicHealthCover.name: National Healthcare Security Administration (basic medical insurance)

depositInsurance.name: Deposit Insurance Fund (Deposit Insurance Regulations, State Council)

statistics.name: National Bureau of Statistics of China
